title: The EU DPP Registry's API and battery data model are out: what to build before February 2027
subtitle: On 30 October 2026 the Commission published the Registry API, its authentication rules and the first semantic model, for batteries. Here is what a battery maker has to build now, and why a successful battery registration is not yet confirmed.
featuredImageAlt: The EU DPP Registry's technical package: an API, two authentication profiles and a layered semantic model for batteries
excerpt: Battery passports must be registered from 18 February 2027. The Commission's 30 October 2026 technical package for the EU DPP Registry adds a registration API, service-account and self-hosted authentication, and a semantic model for batteries. Registration requests JSON, the DCAT catalogue is only announced, and battery registration is still not confirmed.
